checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1518 cards against the MicrosoftDocs and GitHub Docs repositories they quote, found word for word by the card checker, and the Microsoft Learn pages the rest are written from, including every YAML and command snippet
checks.result: Five wrong cards fixed, among them a GITHUB_TOKEN trigger rule that has changed and retirement dates left out for Azure Automation State Configuration and Deployment Environments; 5 ambiguous cards, 5 unsupported claims and 9 unclear cards fixed; one-line YAML that is not valid YAML rewritten; 4 duplicates of GitHub Foundations cards deleted; DORA metrics added.
